$comment: PAGE TEMPLATES (BATCH LE-15, PS-5 (3)): a new page starts from one of these — the sections it is made of, in order (ids from config/sections/<category>.json), drawn in the finish the person chose. A page made from one is a COPY, and takes the site's shared header and footer when the site has them. LE-15 has the ones its sections can make; the twelve of the design (C1 landing · C2 school home · C3 about · C4 news · C5 article · C6 fees · C7 contact · C8 gallery · C9 events · C11 admissions · C12 staff · FAQ) are complete in LE-15e, as their categories arrive.
